ANSWER to "is there tokens lost too with A?" (20:30 CST Nov 14): yes. With a, every reply that holds options repeats one line per option in chat, about 15 to 30 words each (unmeasured per reply). b saves those words but removes the chat copy that the guard option-labels-match-chat compares with the page, so a mismatch between page and chat would go unnoticed. a costs words; b costs a quiet mismatch. #3006 is still an open draft and holds until you answer (GitHub read 20:30 CST Nov 14).
Goal: you answer from one place without retyping options.
Problem (rule): R18 (2026-11-10 16:46 CST) says chat holds one line, "on the page, item N". Main's guard option-labels-match-chat enforces `Page item: <id>` plus `a) <label>` lines, from your 2026-11-08 12:35 CST words "A and B mean the same". #3006 follows R18 and fights that guard.
Based on (ruling): R18; decision option-keys-are-letters.
Departs from: main — main keeps the option lines; choosing b drops them.
Meanwhile: #3006 holds until you answer.
